scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @shopstock/api" "npm run dev -w @shopstock/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shopstock/web && npm run build -w @shopstock/api
scripts.db:reset: docker exec shopstock-mongo mongosh shopstock --quiet --eval "db.getCollectionNames().forEach(c => db[c].deleteMany({})); print('local shopstock DB emptied (indexes kept)')"
